The '''''Auditor''''' was an [[Imperial Customs Corvette]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the ''Auditor'' captured the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vordell]]. Rather than be convicted of his crimes, Vordell made a deal with the crew of the ''Auditor'', to help them recover a missing cargo of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] in return for his freedom. The ''Auditor'' then traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Phinel's Folly]], where Vordell had previously made arrangements with a group of freelance agents for the missing rifles to be brought. Vordell and a detachment from the ''Auditor'' then ambushed the agents on the moon's surface.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
